title: Neuroprotective thiazole sulfonamides against 6-OHDA-induced Parkinsonian model: in vitro biological and in silico pharmacokinetic assessments
content:

Waralee Ruankham, Ratchanok Pingaew, Veda Prachayasittikul, Apilak Worachartcheewan, Suphissara Sathuphong, Setthawut Apiraksattayakul, Tanawut Tantimongcolwat, Virapong Prachayasittikul, Supaluk Prachayasittikul, Kamonrat Phopin
Novel thiazole sulfonamides revealed capabilities against 6-OHDA-induced neuronal damage via SIRT1 activity. Thus, these neuroprotective thiazole sulfonamides could be promising candidates for the further development of effective PD therapy.
